service-conference.title: 1st Annual International Student Union Conference, Faculty of Education, Beijing Normal University (2019)
service-conference.note: I conceived the faculty's first International Student–Faculty Conference as Minister of Academics and saw it fully implemented during my tenure as President of the International Students Association, bringing together local and international students and faculty to exchange research as colleagues.
